rows_data = data_rows('W0::Knot measurements', {'B':'number', 'C':'number'}, 702, 706)
points = sorted([(num('W0::Knot measurements', f'B{r}'), num('W0::Knot measurements', f'C{r}')) for r in rows_data])
def get_y(x):
    for i in range(len(points) - 1):
        x1, y1 = points[i]
        x2, y2 = points[i+1]
        if x1 <= x <= x2:
            return y1 + (y2 - y1) * (x - x1) / (x2 - x1)
    return None
active_points = [p for p in points if 2 <= p[0] <= 18]
sub_pts = [(2, get_y(2))] + active_points + [(18, get_y(18))]
sub_pts = sorted(list(set(sub_pts)))
integral = 0
for i in range(len(sub_pts) - 1):
    x1, y1 = sub_pts[i]
    x2, y2 = sub_pts[i+1]
    integral += 0.5 * (y1 + y2) * (x2 - x1)
result = round(integral, 2)
